title: Keep internal accounting out of storefronts
rule: Remove the provider/catalog count and render accounting from the storefront, or move them to internal diagnostics. If a design selector works, keep its label in ordinary language, for example `Choose a design`. Omit an unusable control; do not imply it works.
counterexample: Swap design / Mountain print / Provider catalog: 120 items · 240 / 240 rendered
rationale: A shopper needs the working choice and product information.
evidence: Migrated from existing SKILL.md guidance. Examples are illustrative; see deslopify/examples/website-copy.md.
